I’m a Data Professional living and working in Melbourne Australia.

My main blog can be found [here](https://samuelrhurst.github.io/). If something catches my eye, and is too good not to share, I’ll post about it there. I also write about my side projects, post how-to articles, and share my thoughts on tech and data topics.

This blog (my code-portfolio portal) is a companion to my main blog, and is where I publish 'computational documents'. All articles published in my codefolio-portal will also be cross-posted to my main blog.
